architecture.algorithm: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) Actor-Critic + Macro Structural Residual

regime_breakdown.description: Fed +425 bps tightening, CPI > 8%, stock-bond correlation spike
Mega-cap AI capex surge, inverted curve, disinflation trend
10Y yield ~4.9–5.1%, positive real yields, selective dispersion

methodology: Walk-Forward Multi-Seed PPO Actor-Critic trained on 2005–2017 with checkpoint selection on 2018–2021 Validation Sortino Ratio and evaluated strictly Out-of-Sample on 2022–2026. Monthly BLS/BEA inflation series (CPI, Core PCE) carry a mandatory +35 calendar-day publication lag; all continuous features use causal 252-day rolling z-scores; weekly rebalancing includes 10 bps one-way transaction costs and a 25% single-stock concentration cap.
